name: core
title: UDesign Core
description: Complete UDesign new-york component and pattern source set.
docs: UDesign core installed. Before you build: every interaction shows a visible change within 100ms; every interactive element has a pressed state; every async control shows pending in itself (Button has a pending prop); a clickable row or card is Pressable, never a div with onClick; durations and easings come from --motion-* roles. Emphasis: one accent-filled control per screen, never inside a repeated row, card, or list item. Read AGENTS.md, then DESIGN.md.
